newsitem.title: UK: UK's Forgemasters mulls reverse takeover-paper.
newsitem.headline: UK's Forgemasters mulls reverse takeover-paper.

text.p: Sheffield Forgemasters, the privately-owned steel forgings group, is considering a reverse takeover of a rival British engineering company as a possible route to a stock market listing, the Financial Times reported on Monday.
The company, a leading international supplier of ingots and large steel castings, is understood to have asked stockbrokers to seek possible acquisition targets according to the newspaper.
It said a reverse takeover was one of the options being contemplated but taht the company had also drawn up plans for a 70 to 80 million stg flotation.
